description: Three-memory-system architecture for sexy-presentation plugin. Each memory system serves a distinct purpose and persists across sessions.

brand.description: Stores brand-specific design preferences, color palettes, typography rules, logo placement guidelines, image style preferences, and tone-of-voice for a particular organization or client.
example_queries: What are Acme Corp's brand colors?
Does this brand prefer serif or sans-serif headings?
What imagery is prohibited for this client?

project.description: Stores decisions and state for the current presentation project: chosen theme, slide plan, design decisions made, image assignments, template selections, and user feedback.
example_queries: What theme was selected for this project?
Which template was used for slide 3?
What visual direction has been established?

design.description: A learning memory that accumulates design principles, successful patterns, user preferences, and anti-patterns across ALL projects. This memory grows over time and improves design quality with each presentation created.
example_queries: What typography pairing works best for data-heavy slides?
What design mistakes should I avoid for timeline slides?
What are the user's general layout preferences?

agent_memory_protocol.description: How agents interact with memory systems
on_start: Load brand memory for the active brand (if set)
Load project memory for the active project
on_complete: Write design decisions to project memory
If user gave positive feedback, record successful pattern in design memory
If user gave negative feedback, record anti-pattern in design memory
on_feedback: Record user feedback in project memory
Update design memory with learned preference
